items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Well I know, I'm more sure Mr. Bill Harrison knows. You see if I ask him.

ctx.x: Even their folks, their daughter, cousin or.

Well I know, I'm more sure Mr. Bill Harrison knows. You see if I ask him. Yeah I try to see him. Cause all them fellas used to play together. You know what I mean? They know you see. He knows, I know he knows. And uh, yeah you see Buddy Johnson, Yank and uh, well you see Buddy Jones they had more of a musical band big time. Yeah, that's what I thought. Yeah you know what I mean? Society band like Celestine had. You see Celestine had a society band itself you see. Till the way out last he went into that Dixieland,…
